focus_areas: Verification of spot pattern naturalness (AI often creates repetitive or overly symmetrical patterns).
Limb-ground contact points (checking for melting into leaves).
Skin texture realism (glossiness vs. plastic-like sheen).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'sharpness' of the yellow spots. In real salamanders, pigment boundaries can have slight irregularities. If the classifier confirms the species but the boundary auditor finds perfectly vector-like edges, flag this as a potential AI artifact. Also, verify if the shadow cast by the salamander matches the ambient lighting of the forest floor.

The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is visible on the left, showing a broad shape, while the tail tapers off towards the right. Four limbs are visible, planted on the leaf litter.
